news.title: EMBASSY: Planned Refinancing And FY2027 Distribution Outlook Will Support Future Payouts
news.body: Analysts have trimmed the price target on Embassy Office Parks REIT slightly from ₹481.35 to ₹479.50, citing updated assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E as key inputs to their revised view. What's in the News Embassy Office Parks REIT issued earnings guidance for FY2027, indicating expected NOI in the range of ₹41,500 million to ₹43,500 million.

news.title: Fourth quarter dividend of ₹6.50 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹6.50. Ex-date: 30th April 2026 Payment date: 8th May 2026 Dividend yield will be 5.9%, which is about the same as the industry average.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.57 (down from ₹17.14 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹46.8b (up 12% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.39b (down 79% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.2% (down from 39% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.1%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 66%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 5.8% growth forecast for the Office REITs industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 6% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 9% per year.

news.title: Embassy Office Parks REIT Declares Distribution for the Fourth Quarter 2026, Payable on or Before May 8, 2026; Provides dividend guidance for FY2027
news.body:
The Board of Directors of Embassy Office Parks Management Services Private Limited (‘EOPMSPL’), Manager to Embassy REIT, at its Board Meeting held earlier, declared a distribution of INR 6,160 million or INR 6.50 per unit for Fourth Quarter FY2026. With this, the cumulative distribution for FY2026 totals INR 23,960 million or INR 25.28 per unit. The record date for the Fourth Quarter FY2026 distribution is April 30, 2026, and the distribution will be paid on or before May 08, 2026.

Embassy Office Parks REIT Provided dividend guidance for FY2027. For the period, the company provides guidance with distributions in the range of Rs 27.00 to Rs 28.60 per unit, implying a 10% YoY growth in distributions at midpoint.

news.title: Embassy Office Parks REIT Provides Dividend Guidance for Fiscal Year of 2027
news.body: Embassy Office Parks REIT Provides dividend guidance for fiscal year of 2027. For the period, the company provide guidance with distributions in the range of INR 27.00 to INR 28.60 per unit, implying a 10% year on year growth in distributions at midpoint.

news.title: Embassy Office Parks REIT Provides Earnings Guidance for Fiscal Year 2027
news.body: Embassy Office Parks REIT provided earnings guidance for Fiscal Year 2027. The company is guiding for double-digit growth in NOI again in FY2027.

news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for Embassy Office Parks REIT at ₹484.76 per unit. A slightly lower discount rate, along with almost unchanged revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions, has resulted in only a minimal adjustment to the overall valuation framework.

news.title: Embassy Office Parks REIT (NSEI:EMBASSY) completed the acquisition of Eleanor Realty Holdings India Private Limited from Tech Park Holdings Pte. Ltd. and Futura Techpark Private Limited.
news.body:
Embassy Office Parks REIT (NSEI:EMBASSY) agreed to acquire Eleanor Realty Holdings India Private Limited from Tech Park Holdings Pte. Ltd. and Futura Techpark Private Limited for an enterprise value of INR 8.5 billion on December 2, 2025. A cash consideration will be paid by Embassy Office Parks REIT.  The enterprise value of INR 8.52 billion is subject to adjustments in relation to net debt, working capital and other adjustments, as agreed among the parties. Upon completion of the Proposed Acquisition, Embassy REIT will hold 100% equity interest in Eleanor Realty Holdings.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Eleanor Realty Holdings India Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 576.91 million.

news.title: Now 20% undervalued
news.body: The stock has been flat over the last 90 days, currently trading at ₹425. The fair value is estimated to be ₹533, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 8.5% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 19%. Revenue is forecast to grow by 26% in 2 years. Earnings are forecast to grow by 162% in the next 2 years.

news.title: EMBASSY: Planned Debt Issue For Acquisitions Will Support Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have revised their price target for Embassy Office Parks REIT to ₹484.76 from ₹465.32, reflecting updated assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E expectations. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on Feb 20, 2026, at 14:10 IST to consider issuing 140,000 listed, rated, secured, redeemable, transferable, rupee denominated, non convertible debentures and the use of proceeds for repayment of existing debt and for capital expenditure at Embassy REIT special purpose vehicles (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.02 (up from ₹1.67 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹12.1b (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.81b (up 141% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 32% (up from 15% in 3Q 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.3%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 83%. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 6.8% growth forecast for the Office REITs industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 13% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.body: Analysts have inched up their price target on Embassy Office Parks REIT to ₹460 from ₹457, citing updated assumptions that combine slightly different revenue growth and discount rate inputs with a marginally higher profit margin and future P/E estimate.
